_note: Generated by cli/scripts/update-connector-catalog.ts from the Grid connector gateway (GET /v1/grid/connectors), the list the Grid app shows. auth: dcr = this computer registers its own OAuth client with the service's MCP server (RFC 7591) and signs in through 127.0.0.1; app = the service has no self-registration, so sign-in goes through the gateway with the Harness account. Grid's app services that also allow self-registration (Linear, Notion, Amplitude, monday.com) sign in from the computer. Snapshot of 2026-10-09; with a Harness sign-in the page follows the gateway's live list.
